findings.criterion: APG radio pattern; review keyboard operability under 2.1.1
findings.actual: Arrow keys and Space do not update the tested focus/selection/tabindex states.
findings.expected: Standard radio keys operate the group and keep checked state and focus synchronized.
recommendations: Prefer native <input type="radio"> controls with labels and a shared name.
For custom radios, implement ArrowRight/Down for next and ArrowLeft/Up for previous, wrapping at both ends.
Space checks the focused option. Set only one aria-checked="true".
Keep tabindex="0" on the checked option (first option if none checked), and "-1" on the others.

findings.actual: Clicking Upper leaves Lower checked.
findings.expected: Clicking a radio updates the selection and its programmatic state.
recommendations: Handle click selection using the same update function as the keyboard handlers.
Update aria-checked, tabindex, focus and selected appearance together.

findings.actual: Find Trains reveals the results count without status/live-region semantics; focus stays on the button.
findings.expected: The result count is available to assistive technology as a status update.
recommendations: Create an initially empty, visible role="status" container before the action.
Update its text to "3 trains found" after search; keep the result list separately structured.

findings.actual: The clickable span opens Terms with a mouse, but has no native button role, is outside the Tab sequence and cannot receive focus for Enter activation.
findings.expected: The action is reachable and operable by keyboard with appropriate semantics.
recommendations: Replace the span with <button type="button">Terms and conditions</button>.
Place the separate terms button outside the checkbox label to avoid nested interactive controls.
Keep a clear visible focus indicator and a meaningful accessible name.

findings.criterion: Manual design review — disclosure versus dialog
findings.actual: The revealed terms content is an ordinary div. Its name suggests a dialog, but the page does not establish modal behavior.
findings.expected: Choose and implement a consistent disclosure or dialog pattern.
recommendations: For an inline disclosure, use a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls; keep content in logical reading order.
If a modal dialog is intended, use a named <dialog> opened with showModal(), initial focus, Escape close and focus return.
Do not add aria-modal="true" unless interaction outside the dialog is actually blocked.
